title: The monitoring router speaks Cyclotron's decision contract
description: Cyclotron step 3 (docs/general-decision-engine.md in AnthusAI/Cyclotron): the router calls /machine/bindings/{id}/operations and /commands/{job}, sends contractVersion cyclotron-decision/v1, reads bindingId and the decisions map, and sends feedback as caller/reviewer instead of editor {site, subject}. Papyrus's own config keeps publicationId. The curation host and routing selection client stay on cyclotron-publication/v1 until Cyclotron gives its curation routes a neutral form.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged to develop in AnthusAI/Papyrus#878 (2026-10-30), CI green. Branch feature/PPY-570706-decision-contract. Verification: router pytest 196 passed; new feature monitoring-decision-contract (4 scenarios) and the monitoring features pass; the full suites fail only where untouched develop fails locally. Not deployed: the papyrus-monitoring router is older than main and develop carries unreleased router changes, so it ships with the next release through a change set a person reads. No develop to main PR from this work (release PR #876 is open).
